lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: ... She's not picking up.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Yoyo?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Sh-she's retired, remember?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: And... she probably doesn't want to hear from anyone right now,

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: e-especially us.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Still, we gotta clear this up. We didn't do anything...

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: right?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Y-yeah... I mean, it did cross my mind.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: I just thought you probably really hated her.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: ... Yeah, thanks.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: But after that, we really didn't get much work, did we?

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: Yeah, it's down to a third.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: ... I don't want to assume the worst, but something isn't right.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: I think we may have gotten on Tetra's bad side.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: If anything, this just proves my point.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: I wonder... what's going to happen to us.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Where's Boss?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Um... H-he said he was going out to drum up some work.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: He should be back in about an hour.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Okay, let's at least do some quick cleaning or something while we wait...
*Bang!*
The office door bursts open.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: EEEEEEEEEntertainment!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Enchanté, T.T. STAR!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: The mastermind behind every show in the Ark? C'est moi.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: The one and only C! E! O! of Tetra Line!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Mustang, at your service!

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: *Gasp!*

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Eek!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Oh? I take it I surprised you, oui?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Pardon, pardon, I do have a habit of surprising people.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Mesdames, mind if I steal a moment?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Huh? W-wait, what...?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Wh-why is Mustang... no, why's Mr. Mustang here...?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Oh,

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: you're not the real one, right?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Non, non! Don't be ridiculous! I am the real Mustang!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: The god of entertainment!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: The one and only C! E! O! of Tetra Line!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Mustang, c'est moi!
Mustang gives a light clap.
As if on cue, the aides waiting outside file in, laying out a spread of gifts across the table.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Let's be très direct, shall we?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: T.T. STAR,

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: the Ark's newest star,

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I want to sign you, mes chéris.
Mustang slides a contract across the table.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Read it. Allez, don't be shy.
Riss takes the contract and scans it.
Her eyes flick rapidly across the pages
before setting it back on the table.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: This is... quite bold.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Of course, when I scout someone, my picks are always très unique!

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Bold... how bold are we talking?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Yoyo's level, or maybe even higher.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Wh-why us, of all people...?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Your rise on the indie charts? Absolutely meteoric!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: To grow this fast in such a ruthless world? C'est remarquable! Honestly, it moved me!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: But that's just part of the raison.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: The real raison?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I was genuinely impressionné by your sincérité!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You said you want to carry on Pretty's legacy, oui?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Not her glamour, but her mind, her spirit. Oui, exactly that.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Y-yeah...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I've been waiting for a pop star with inner beauté,

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: not just the flashy extérieur.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: And at last, I've found it in you,

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: T.T. STAR.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Allez, sign it.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Come with me, and you will become the pop star to carry on Pretty's legacy. Magnifique, non?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: S-sorry, our boss is out right now, so we can't decide straight away.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Oh? Then do take a look at the other contract underneath, s'il vous plaît.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Oh... so it's being passed on like that... I see...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Oui.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: The condition is that all members of T.T. STAR have to agree.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: If even one person disagrees, the succession will be void.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: ... What's that supposed to mean?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: If the three of us sign here, Boss and Riss will come along too, with their roles staying exactly the same.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: And if even one of us doesn't sign, the whole thing's off.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: So we either all go, or none of us do.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: And we're calling the shots.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Wait, hold on... If our boss goes to Tetra, does that make him the boss over there?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You may not be aware of this, mes chéris...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Hanson was once a member of Tetra's board.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: So naturally, he'll be returning to that position, bien sûr.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Boss... back as a director at some big-name company...?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I'll be frank.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: This place is wasting your talent, vraiment.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You should be flying under Tetra's banner, not wasting away in a second-rate office, non?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Let's be honest, aside from T.T. STAR, this office has nothing going for it, n'est-ce pas?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: And yet, we're prepared to bring your boss and manager along. Généreux, wouldn't you say?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: That's how much we want you, compris?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: So, sign.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You'll remain ensemble, just as you are now.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Only this time, with the backing of Tetra Line, bien sûr.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: There's something I'd like to ask.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Go on, I'm all ears, ma chérie.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: I might be overthinking it, but it's felt like Tetra Line's been targeting us.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Packing our schedule tighter and tighter, and taking away our ad deals.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Would you mind explaining that?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: And if you don't mind my asking, why did our boss leave Tetra Line in the first place?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Hm...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Perceptive, très perceptive. I like you already.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Oui. If I'm bringing in a future superstar, I'll have to make it worth their while too, d'accord?
Mustang turns around as the aides make their way out the door.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Hanson is my fils.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: What... did you just say?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Oui, he's my son.
Mustang lets out a deep sigh, then speaks in a low, measured voice.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I devoted everything to entertainment

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: and neglected my family in the process.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I never grew close to my son. After my wife passed away from illness, the distance between us only grew.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I wanted to close that distance since he's my family, my son.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: So I gave him a seat on Tetra's board and had him learn the ropes.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I thought working together might repair what had already broken...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: And that he might one day succeed me.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: But Hanson resented me.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: To him, it was much too late.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I didn't know how to be a father, so I treated him the only way I knew how—harshly.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: But that only drove him further away, until all that remained between us was a distance neither of us could cross.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Then I pushed harder, and he grew tired of it.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: ... Eventually, he left the company, and I heard he's producing you now.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: So, I'll be honest.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I believed that if I made Hanson suffer, he would return to Tetra.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: For what you went through as a result, you have my sincere apologies.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: As for Yoyo, her actions are entirely her own, and she'll be dealt with accordingly.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I'm aware this offers little comfort. Still, I hope it offers some.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I want to reconcile with Hanson.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I'm aware there were flaws in the way I handled things, but I don't know how to correct them.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: That's why I'm asking you to act as the bridge between us.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You have the talent to become top stars. That much is undeniable.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: By helping Hanson guide you into carrying on Pretty's legacy,

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I intend to apologize

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: and make amends with him.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I don't want to be remembered as a disgrace of a father. I would prefer to be a proper one.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: This is my request.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Help us... no, help me.
Mustang bows his head.
A ripple of shock runs through the room, and almost at once, their thoughts turn to Hanson.
They think of all he has endured.
The one who wakes earlier than anyone else to take care of his pop stars, and stays up later than anyone, preparing for tomorrow and whatever comes next.
The one who keeps them from losing heart, who cheers them on, and lifts them back up.
He bows his head to others, asks for help, gets turned away, yet still bows again.
And through it all, he never lets it show how hard it is.
He just endures and believes in them, without wavering.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I just want our boss to be happy.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I feel the same.
Hanson drags himself back to the office, exhausted.
Still, the day's results aren't bad. He's sure everyone will be pleased.
The moment he opens the door, something feels off.
Things he's never seen before are laid out across the table.
Expensive liquor. Luxury sweets. High-end accessories.
Hanson knows exactly how much they're worth,
which is precisely why they feel so out of place here.
He looks up.
All four of them are watching him, as though they might burst into tears at any moment.
For a split second, his heart sinks,
then he realizes it isn't sadness. It's joy.
Anis smiles and holds out a document.
But Hanson can't help but wonder whether they've won the lottery.
He takes it, pulse quickening.
His eyes widen as soon as he sees it—the Tetra Line logo stamped boldly across the front.
He skims through it,
then looks up again, stunned.
They're still watching him, on the verge of tears, but this time, it's unmistakably from happiness.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: This is...
Hanson feels like everything is crashing down.
The room is steeped in darkness,
luggage piled up in every corner.
The only light comes from her phone, casting a faint glow.
Yoyo sits motionless, eyes fixed blankly on the screen.
She checks her messages.
Only a few from Anis. Nothing from her colleagues. Nothing from the staff.
She logs onto the online forums.
Every post is just more hate directed at her.
Page three. Page five. Page ten. No matter how far she scrolls, it's all the same.
Here and there, she spots posts expressing sympathy for T.T. STAR.
Yoyo scrolls faster, digging through the flood of posts, searching for even one message meant for her—something comforting, something to hold onto.
There's nothing, or maybe there is. But she just can't see it.
She stares at the screen, growing more and more fixated.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: I lost everything...

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Is this... karma or something?
She continues to scroll through the fan community.
Her name from when she was human, photos, countless personal details—everything is out there, spreading as if it's nothing.
Anis's personal information is already spreading online.
She taps in to check the posts. They're filled with words of sympathy and comfort for the lonely life Anis lived.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: I lost everything again.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: She took what was mine again.
STAR ANIS: To Be Continued...
